screens.name: Approach — opening and transition

screens.name: Onboarding — optional birthday

screens.name: Onboarding — age confirmation after Skip
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows explicit age choices; supplied retained evidence reports acceptance, decline, reload and blocked requests before eligibility.
findings: Retain both explicit age choices and add direct 200% capture coverage for this particular confirmation state.

screens.name: Onboarding — age restriction
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows restriction at normal and 200% text; supplied evidence reports persistent restriction without a bypass.
findings: Use correction wording that also fits users who selected an age category without entering a birthday.

screens.name: Onboarding — birthday correction
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show correction and return actions, with the example visibly cut off inside the enlarged input.
findings: Move the example into wrapping helper text so its final date digit remains visible at 200%.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus unselected

findings: Explain that Meet the Ball continues without a selection, since the instruction says skip but no Skip action is labeled.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus selected, normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 16–17 show the selected row with gold text, underline and checkmark; the enlarged primary action extends below the capture.

screens.name: Ask — question composer, normal and enlarged

screens.name: Ask — named-person editor, normal and 200%

screens.name: Planning — loading

screens.name: Adaptive card 1 — plan readiness

screens.name: Research — loading

components.name: Circle surface

components.name: Age confirmation

components.name: Focus selection

components.name: Birth-profile surface

components.name: Named-person control

components.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show preparing and failed export states; supplied evidence reports duplicate-activation protection and successful retry.

components.name: Outcome selector
components.evidence: Sheets 07 and 17–18 show unanswered and all three saved outcomes with text and checkmark confirmation.
findings: Give the three outcomes a more defined shared control boundary while preserving text-based selected feedback.

limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments based on the supplied screenshots and runtime narrative; no independent runtime inspection was performed.

A equals the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F equals the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall equals 0.4A + 0.6F, rounded to one decimal, excluding genuinely inapplicable null dimensions.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across every screen and component.
No hard-gate failure is established by this material; content below a screenshot boundary is not evidence of an unreachable action, particularly given the reported layout and reachability checks.
Transition pairs support visual consistency but do not independently demonstrate animation continuity, input responsiveness or absence of intermediate layout shifts.
Runtime reports combine current checks with explicitly retained earlier checks; those retained behaviors were not independently rerun for this evaluation.
Synthetic prediction, reasoning, source and history text was treated as layout stress content, not evidence of model quality or a production-copy defect.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native text scaling, hardware timing, microphone, haptics, real payments and OS share delivery remain unverified and prevent full native certification.
Reported DOM contrast checks do not establish raster text contrast in exported images, and host timing does not establish phone performance.
The screenshots do not directly show every pressed state, geocoding result or failure state, populated connected Circle state, or semantic target measurement.
topFixes: Fix date guidance: keep examples outside inputs and explain impossible dates specifically.
Improve 200% task density by reducing nonessential spacing around headings, profile content and supporting artwork without shrinking text.
Clarify ambiguous actions: Back to choices, continuing without a focus, retrying a failed download and opening history rows.
Make source titles directly actionable and provide quicker access to the share image’s scalable transcript.
Reduce oversized notices and place recovery explanations beside their relevant controls.
Capture the remaining browser interaction states and target measurements before considering the browser threshold met.
